messages.en:
{07 0d 00}Welcome to {04 01 00}'s
{ff 00 00 02}Mega Mart{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} where the deals
grab you by the lapels...
And punch you square in
the teeth!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Tere tulemast {04 01 00}
{ff 00 00 02}Megapoodi{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kus pakkumised
haaravad sul revääridest...
Ja löövad otse
hammaste pihta!

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Whoa! I didn't think you'd
show up, {04 1f 00}!

{07 0d 00}Wow! I sure am glad I
cleaned my place,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Ohoo! Ma ei arvanud, et sa
kohale tuled, {04 1f 00}!

{07 0d 00}Vau! Hea, et ma oma
koha ära koristasin,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 17 00}For some reason, having you
in my house gives my belly
a case of the butterflies{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 17 00}Millegipärast tekitab sinu
kohalolek mu majas kõhus
liblikaid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
